brand_note: suite_cohesion uses the four pinned KyIdentity originals. Shell is N/A on signed-out login only. Dialog shells scored 8 because the scrim obscures them.

pixel_only_counterfactual.method: Prior round4 vector with only the dimension changes I attribute to visible stage03->04 pixels applied
pixel_only_counterfactual.reading: Visible pixel change alone moves my round4 vectors to this mean; the remainder of the delta is my own calibration on unchanged content and is NOT product gain.

brand_drift.explanation: Pixels: light field/secondary/icon outlines visibly darker and icon buttons 40px, worth at most +1 on palette_tokens (light) and type_geometry. Calibration: the rest of palette_tokens (light 7->9), suite_cohesion +1 on shell screens after re-viewing the KyIdentity references, and dialog shell moved from N/A to 8 (method change: an obscured shell is now scored with a caveat). Brand never enters quality or progression.

rows.explanation: Password/SSO/select outlines are visibly darker (F1 pixels, light color +1). Hierarchy +1 and coherence +1 are calibration: the nested status box (F7) and corner select are unchanged; I now judge them minor.

Refresh, row-menu and sign-out buttons are now 40px with the darker field-border outline, and the search outline is darker (F1/F2 pixels: color +1, coherence +1). Phone density +1 is calibration: the two-row header and wrapped toolbar layout are unchanged.
Same visible F1/F2 change as Files (color +1, coherence +1). Phone density +1 is calibration on an unchanged layout.
